headline: Bollywood star Aamir Khan to marry Gauri Spratt on July 5 in private ceremony
summary: The actor confirmed the wedding date and described it as an intimate, home-based celebration with close family and friends.
details: Bollywood actor Aamir Khan has confirmed that he will marry his longtime partner, Gauri Spratt, on July 5 in a private ceremony.
Speaking to the media during a screening of 'Pritam and Pedro', Aamir described the wedding as a simple, home-based celebration attended only by immediate family and a small group of close friends.
The actor expressed his desire for the couple to receive blessings and prayers from fans as they begin this new chapter together.
Aamir first introduced Gauri Spratt to the public in March 2025 during his 60th birthday celebrations, after keeping their relationship private for several years.
This will mark Aamir's third marriage. He was previously married to Reena Dutta and filmmaker Kiran Rao, maintaining cordial relationships with both former spouses.
Professionally, the actor was most recently seen in the film 'Sitaare Zameen Par'.
caption:
Aamir Khan is tying the knot! 💍

The Bollywood star has confirmed he will marry Gauri Spratt on July 5.

Bollywood actor Aamir Khan has confirmed that he will marry his longtime partner, Gauri Spratt, on July 5 in a private ceremony.

Speaking to the media during a screening of 'Pritam and Pedro', Aamir described the wedding as a simple, home-based celebration attended only by immediate family and a small group of close friends.

The actor expressed his desire for the couple to receive blessings and prayers from fans as they begin this new chapter together.

Aamir first introduced Gauri Spratt to the public in March 2025 during his 60th birthday celebrations, after keeping their relationship private for several years.

This will mark Aamir's third marriage. He was previously married to Reena Dutta and filmmaker Kiran Rao, maintaining cordial relationships with both former spouses.

Professionally, the actor was most recently seen in the film 'Sitaare Zameen Par'.

headline_marked: Reports: [[Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce wedding celebrations]] begin in NYC
headline: Reports: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce wedding celebrations begin in NYC
summary: The pop star and NFL star are reportedly hosting a series of high-profile events at Madison Square Garden, sparking widespread speculation about their marriage.
details: Taylor Swift and her fiancé, NFL star Travis Kelce, have sparked fresh speculation about their upcoming wedding after hosting a high-profile gathering in New York City.
The event, held at Madison Square Garden on Thursday evening, was attended by several celebrity friends, including actress Lena Dunham and music producer Jack Antonoff.
While neither Swift nor Kelce has publicly confirmed the purpose of the gathering, media reports suggest it may have been a pre-wedding celebration or rehearsal dinner.
Around 100 guests attended Thursday's function, with a larger celebration expected to host up to 1,000 invitees the following day.
Security was heavily tightened around Madison Square Garden, with police cordoning off areas and restricting public access to ensure privacy.
Television crews and photographers captured a steady stream of black SUVs arriving with formally dressed guests, while aerial footage showed a white-canopied entrance.
Signage at the venue indicated that visitors between June 29 and July 3 would consent to photography and video recording, further fueling rumors of filming.
Swift and Kelce have not yet commented publicly on the reports, leaving fans awaiting official confirmation of the wedding festivities.
caption:
Is it official? Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are reportedly celebrating their wedding in New York City!

Taylor Swift and her fiancé, NFL star Travis Kelce, have sparked fresh speculation about their upcoming wedding after hosting a high-profile gathering in New York City.

The event, held at Madison Square Garden on Thursday evening, was attended by several celebrity friends, including actress Lena Dunham and music producer Jack Antonoff.

While neither Swift nor Kelce has publicly confirmed the purpose of the gathering, media reports suggest it may have been a pre-wedding celebration or rehearsal dinner.

Around 100 guests attended Thursday's function, with a larger celebration expected to host up to 1,000 invitees the following day.

Security was heavily tightened around Madison Square Garden, with police cordoning off areas and restricting public access to ensure privacy.

Television crews and photographers captured a steady stream of black SUVs arriving with formally dressed guests, while aerial footage showed a white-canopied entrance.

Signage at the venue indicated that visitors between June 29 and July 3 would consent to photography and video recording, further fueling rumors of filming.

Swift and Kelce have not yet commented publicly on the reports, leaving fans awaiting official confirmation of the wedding festivities.
